about.story_subtitle: Accompanying you on the journey to find inspiring living spaces.
about.story_text_1: Originating from the aspiration to redefine the standard of luxury accommodation, Domin Tactic not only provides comfortable apartments but also creates an elite living ecosystem, where every single detail is meticulously curated by leading architects.
about.story_text_2: We believe that a perfect living space must be a harmonious combination of sophisticated design, modern technology, and dedicated service. Domin Tactic is proud to accompany thousands of tenants and homeowners in building authentic sanctuaries.
about.values_subtitle: The principles that guide all actions and designs at Domin Tactic.
about.value_1_desc: All apartment information and booking statuses are 100% transparent and verified by the Domin team.
about.value_2_desc: Eliminating redundant details, focusing on minimalism, optimal space utilization, and natural light.
about.value_3_desc: The Domin Concierge butler team is always ready to support you 24/7 with the highest professional spirit.
about.value_4_desc: Each living space is flexibly customized to bring the maximum comfort and suitability to your lifestyle.
about.philosophy_desc: We apply the strict 'No-Line' rule in both interface design and physical spaces. Boundaries are established through subtle transitions in color tones and natural light, delivering a peaceful, seamless, and timelessly luxurious experience.

services.hero_subtitle: Caring for every moment of your vacation with premium standard services.
services.intro_desc: At Domin Tactic, we bring exclusive personalized amenities to each tenant, ensuring a flawless and worry-free luxury stay.
services.request_form_desc: Select the service you need and submit. A Domin Concierge butler will contact you within 15 minutes.

list.item_1_desc: Premium private two-way chauffeured transport between the airport and your residence.
list.item_2_desc: Professional butler support for dining reservations, grocery shopping, or resolving accommodation needs.
list.item_3_desc: Enjoy world-class dining experiences prepared directly in your apartment by top culinary chefs.
list.item_4_desc: Rejuvenate your mind and body with therapeutic wellness treatments in the absolute privacy of your home.
list.item_5_desc: Ensure your residence remains in pristine condition with 5-star professional cleaning standards.
list.item_6_desc: Custom itinerary planning, private tours, professional guides, and fast-track ticketing to premium sites.
